name: virtuoso
description: Provider-based governance & dispatch suite: roadmap planning, execution discipline, close-outs, mid-dispatch decisions, audits, and doc hygiene, joined into a learning loop in which every close-out records its lessons and every new specification is checked against them — driven by a per-project registry that declares its live work register, terminal ledger, ownership rules, and permitted mutations.

interface.shortDescription: Governance and dispatch discipline for agent-run projects
interface.longDescription: Use Virtuoso to plan a roadmap, dispatch work at a declared effort level, decide mid-dispatch without losing the thread, close out against a terminal ledger, prepare outside audits, and keep project documentation honest. The ceremonies form one learning loop: every close-out records what the work taught, and every new specification and epic is checked against those lessons before it runs — all driven by a per-project registry that declares where the work lives and what may change it.
defaultPrompt: Set this project up for governed dispatch.
What should we dispatch next, and at what effort?
Close out this dispatch and record what it taught.
